newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Konsortium says to negotiate buying MISC stake.
newsitem.headline: Konsortium says to negotiate buying MISC stake.

text.p: Shipping and transport firm Konsortium Perkapalan Bhd said it has received approval from the central bank to begin negotiations to buy a stake in Malaysian International Shipping Corp Bhd (MISC).

Konsortium said in a statement on Thursday it received the approval from Bank Negara Malaysia to commence negotiations with Kumpulan Wang Amanah Pencen for the acquisition of the pnesion fund's 29.35 percent stake in MISC.
"Official negotiation is expected to commence in due course," Konsortium said.
The company asked the stock exchange to extend the suspension of its stock and that of its affiliate, Diperdana Corp Bhd.
